messages.subject: showing output of regression model
parts:
Hello,

I'm creating a shiny app with lots of slider bars that represent my independent variables. In my main panel, I just want to display one value for my dependent variable, which changes based on the slider bars. I have a regression model linked to this and am using predict.lm to do this. 

In my server.R, the model part of my code looks like this: 

  predictModel <- reactive({
   a <- lm(y ~ x + .....
   
   predict(a,????)
  })

output$model <- renderTable({
    predictModel()
  }) 

What do I put in the predict function? I know I start with my model a, but how do I code which data it reads from the slider values I also have in my code?

Thanks,
Theo

messages.subject: Re: showing output of regression model
parts:
Try this

shiny::runGist("50a3f45da3b4ab1008d8")

ui.R
library(shiny)

shinyUI(basicPage(
  headerPanel("Model"),
  sliderInput("speed",label="Speed",min=0,max=25,value=15),
  dataTableOutput("model")
))

server.R

library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input,output) {
  
  predictModel <- reactive({
    a <- lm(dist ~ speed,data=cars)
            
    predict(a,data.frame(speed = c(1,input$speed,25)))
  })
  
  output$model <- renderDataTable({
    print(predictModel())    
    d = data.frame(mile = as.vector(predictModel()))
    d
  }) 
})
